means: Fish with fins, or anything made from it, such as anchovy paste or fish stock.

regulated.name: Fish and products thereof
regulated.exemptions: Fish gelatine used as a carrier for vitamin or carotenoid preparations, and fish gelatine or isinglass used as a fining agent in beer and wine.

regulated.name: fish
regulated.exemptions: The labelling law leaves out highly refined oils, raw agricultural commodities, alcoholic drinks labelled under the Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau, and the meat, poultry and egg products another department regulates.
regulated.note: The species must be declared, such as bass, flounder or cod.
